nodes.label: laptop memory - trust revoked, explicit instruction only

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. The user revoked trust at the end of the 2026-07-16 session. The causes: aborting his running tests without being asked, chained fix-everything sequences he could not see or interact with, runs launched in invisible background tasks, a destroyed venv that held unrecoverable version information, editing a script while he was launching it, and multi-step command dumps when he wanted one thing - every one of them converting his questions and opinions into actions, against his explicit rule stated earlier the same day: 'me having an opinion will NEVER be a command.' Take no action - no edits, no commits, no installs, no process starts or stops, no while-I'm-at-it fixes - without an explicit instruction naming that action; questions get answers, opinions get an honest read, and neither gets a tool call beyond read-only lookups; one thing at a time, propose the single next step then stop. CANON_AUDIT.md 4.5 verdict: GROUNDED at origin, STALE in its absolutist form - he then spent two weeks demanding the opposite ('just fucking DO shit ok' 07-21, 'build it ffs' 07-31), and read absolutely this entry produces the passivity he complained about
